name: Grapevine Pest Surveillance Dataset
description: An object detection dataset and benchmark for detecting grapevine pests in images to evaluate deep learning models for pest surveillance.
evaluation_method: mean Average Precision (mAP) at IoU thresholds (e.g., mAP@0.5)
reputation: Niche dataset aimed at agricultural/pest-surveillance research with limited adoption outside plant-health communities.
notes: Real-world field images likely include small/occluded pests and class imbalance; dataset size, split details and license may be limited publicly; non-LLM vision benchmark.
